messages.text: Hi Nicholas. What can I help you with today?
My nexus S1 came with the wrong power supply
Handed to the team · Packing error, correct power supply needs to be shipped; second time he has aske

Sorry, Nicholas, you shouldn't have had to ask twice. Your S1 shipped on Oct 17 and the box should have had the LRS-350, so that's a packing error on us.

I've put it back in front of the team now to get the correct supply out to you. Stay in the chat if you can, someone will jump in here, and the answer comes to (email hidden) either way.

If you want the fastest word on whether the LRS-200 is safe to run meanwhile, JD is on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.
It’s really not a big deal. I had an extra lrs 350 laying around

Good, that saves you the wait then. Still, you paid for the LRS-350, so the team will get one out to you anyway, and you keep the spare.

Anything else going on with the S1, or with the B30 on your other order?
Can they just credit my account for the power supply?
Handed to the team · Customer prefers credit instead of the replacement part; the value of the LRS-35

That's a fair ask, and I've put it to the team with your order. The supply isn't a separate line on Shop····, so the amount is theirs to set, not mine to quote.

They've been pinged and one of them will come in here with it. If you step away, it comes to your email instead.
Yes I would like to hear when the B30 might arrive

Your B30 on Shop···· ships November 7, with the Power Kit in the same box. It's not on the shelf yet, it comes in with the batch heading to our warehouse, and you can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking emails go to (email hidden) automatically once it leaves.
